spec.title: The Underground Railroad
spec.caption: Brave people risked everything to guide enslaved people to freedom in the North.
spec.event: In the 1800s, freedom seekers, station masters, and conductors worked in secret to escape slavery.
prompts: Why did you join the journey?

views.label: A Freedom Seeker
answers: I wanted to live free and own my life.
Slave catchers and wild dogs chased us through dark woods.
The North Star showed me the way every night.

views.label: A Station Master
answers: Every human being deserves to be free and safe.
The law said helping runaways was a terrible crime.
Seeing tired travelers reach safety gave me great strength.

views.label: A Conductor
answers: I knew secret paths that could lead people out of bondage.
Cold weather and hidden patrols threatened us on every trip.
Bravo souls whispering freedom songs kept my spirit strong.

g4-railroad.label: Voices Along the Way
g4-railroad.tutoringBrief: Guide the student to see how each person took great risks for freedom.
g4-railroad.transitionCue: Now let us test your knowledge on the secret vocabulary used along the route.
